target.title: fix(update): keep repair JSON output parseable
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running `openclaw update repair --json` could receive exit code 0 while stdout contained Doctor and nested gateway-service output before the final result. Consumers parsing the complete stdout stream would therefore fail even though the command reported success.

## Why This Change Was Made

JSON update finalization now gives its embedded Doctor run a stderr-backed runtime and UI stream. Doctor scopes terminal notes to that stream across async work and forwards it through gateway-service stage, install, and restart operations. Human and non-JSON Doctor callers retain their existing runtime and stdout defaults.

The routing stays at the embedding update finalizer and Doctor lifecycle boundaries instead of monkey-patching process-global stdout.

## User Impact

Automation can parse the complete stdout from `openclaw update repair --json` as one JSON value. Human update-repair behavior is unchanged.

## Evidence

Final exact candidate: `256542f28e268f20bb6257ec540f8eee1974bff4` over public main `047232bd16e407cf53762eb6ffa80d400b1d249e`.

Validated with Node `24.15.0` and pnpm `11.2.2`:

- scoped terminal-note and terminal-restore output: 6/6
- real Doctor/Clack UI composition: 1/1
- gateway-service repair lifecycle: 49/49
- changed JSON and human update-finalization cases: 6/6
- targeted oxfmt: 10/10 files
- targeted core oxlint: 0 warnings and 0 errors
- max-lines ratchet, conflict-marker, changelog-attribution, secret, dangerous-construct, and diff checks passed
- final worktree clean

A predecessor with identical successful JSON routing was also exercised through the real source command with isolated state: `openclaw update repair --json --no-restart --timeout 60 --yes` exited 0, emitted one parseable 549-byte JSON document on stdout, and kept real Doctor UI on stderr.

The final SHA additionally covers rich-TTY error exits. Regression tests verify that finalization failures, embedded Doctor exits, and pre-mutation JSON failures route terminal reset bytes to stderr instead of appending ANSI to stdout.

The full update CLI test file and full repository build were not rerun on the final SHA; GitHub CI remains the broad verification gate.

AI-assisted: Meles prepared and exercised the original candidate. Cad independently reviewed it, removed unrelated replay noise, fixed a reviewer-found JSON error-path blocker, rebased it onto current main, and reran the exact-head focused matrix.
